primary_reference_rule: Use the benchmark-designated primary reference; otherwise stable sorted reference ID.

governed_rules.metric: E1 only when expected and selected metric IDs are both present and semantically differ.
governed_rules.slot: E1 only when metric matches and frozen slot payload directly differs.
governed_rules.compiler: E2 only when grounding matches and compiled candidate semantics deterministically differ from the canonical reference; result mismatch alone is insufficient.
governed_rules.false_governed: E1/E2 only when expected-direct and actual-governed provenance establishes governed scope overreach; never claim the direct counterfactual would be correct.

memory_rules.current_artifact_gap: M10R ledger and provider captures do not retain retrieved memory IDs, scores, or SQL; memory transfer and selectivity are therefore unclassifiable, not disproven.

direct_rule: AST structure is explanatory only. Assign E2 only where a semantically relevant, intervention-specific difference is deterministic and no higher-priority cause applies.
controls: Analyze all 28 V1-correct cases alongside the 172 failures; report feature prevalence without causal claims.
manual_review: Only after automated outputs are hashed; manual annotations are E4 and cannot change primary mechanism, correctness, score, route or denominator.
